ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Two edits to the accepted-risks gate job in security.yml, both STRENGTHENING and neither touching the trust boundary's inputs. (1) Its pytest step now runs the WHOLE scripts/ci/tests directory instead of one named file, so the vendored sha256 drift guard and the header/manifest provenance checks run on the SCHEDULED trigger too, not only on pull_request; without that the weekly run executed vendored code whose byte-integrity was last checked whenever the previous PR landed (Stage-3 doubt review D-5). A directory also cannot go stale: the same change split those invariants into three modules, and a hardcoded file list would have silently dropped two. (2) A comment whose concrete example named the lapsed-suppression invariant this run retired was repointed at a still-live example. No trigger, permission, action, pin or installed package changed; the job still declares permissions {contents: read}, still runs check + expire, and carries no continue-on-error or job-level if. The GitHub-owned vs third-party action-pinning asymmetry (DO-NOT #25) is untouched.
